title.en: old town walk with graz tourism.
title.tr: graz tourism ile eski şehir yürüyüşü.

line.en: the graz tourism old town walk starts at 10:30 every day in november, in german and english. in november you must book until 13:30 on the day itself. it runs in any weather.
line.de: der altstadt-rundgang von graz tourismus beginnt im november täglich um 10:30 uhr, auf deutsch und englisch. im november bis 13:30 uhr am selben tag anmelden. er findet bei jedem wetter statt.
line.tr: graz tourism altstadt yürüyüşü kasımda her gün 10:30'da başlar, almanca ve ingilizce. kasımda aynı gün 13:30'a kadar kayıt gerekir. her havada yapılır.

sparks.why: Graz Tourismus Altstadt-Rundgang, daily 10:30 in November, booking until 13:30 on the day, runs in any weather (steiermark.com event listing, ed_41617106).
